description.summary: This spell imbues a single creature with great bravery and morale in battle.
description.value: This spell imbues a single creature with great bravery and morale in battle. The target gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks. Heroism, Greater School enhancing ( compulsion ) [ mind-affecting ]; Level astrologian 6, white mage 6 EFFECT Duration 1 min./level DESCRIPTION This spell functions like heroism , except the creature gains a +4 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks, immunity to fear effects, and temporary hit points equal to your caster level (maximum 20).
